featured.title: Sam Altman · OpenAI CEO
featured.summaryEn: Sam Altman proposed that frontier model developers jointly establish shared norms for evaluating models and red-teaming safety cases, including shared transparency standards. He further suggested common limits based on perplexity and other measurements that labs commit not to cross until the ability to understand and monitor AI behavior reaches a concrete milestone (such as a successor to CoT monitors). He added that labs already agreed under the White House Accords to set safety standards, and a discussion about…
featured.insightZh: Sam Altman 提出前沿模型开发者应共同建立评估与红队安全论证的共享规范（含透明度标准），并进一步建议基于 perplexity 等指标设定行业共同“发展上限”：在 AI 行为的理解与监控能力达到某个具体里程碑（例如 CoT 监控的继任方案）之前，各家承诺不越过该上限。他补充称，各实验室已在“白宫协议”（White House Accords）下同意建立安全标准与最佳实践，围绕 perplexity 的讨论有助于推进这一目标。

featured.title: Swyx · Latent Space / AI Engineer / Cognition
featured.summaryEn: Swyx unpacked OpenAI's proposal to use perplexity, rather than FLOPS, as a universal metric for industry self-regulation and pacing: since new capabilities mainly emerge from progress in compression, a perplexity-based measure could serve as a shared benchmark for general intelligence, with further transformative capabilities expected in the ~0.68–0.7 log-perplexity window. He called the chart one of the most beautiful ways to tell the story of the last four years, framing post-training debates as the B plot to la…
featured.insightZh: Swyx 解读了 OpenAI 提议将 perplexity 作为行业自律与节奏控制的通用指标（而非 FLOPS）：其逻辑是新能力主要来自压缩能力的进步，因此基于 perplexity 的度量可作为通用智能的共享基准，并预计进入约 0.68–0.7 log-perplexity 区间时将出现更多变革性能力。他认为这张图是讲述过去四年最漂亮的方式，也说明很多后训练争论只是大规模预训练进步这条主线之外的“B 线”；按这个指标今年的 AI 进步比 2022–2025 加起来还多，但体感上未必如此。另外他推荐了一份从创业到被收购的完整创始人复盘，涵盖 IP 归属、招聘与裁员、如何促成收购等经验。

featured.title: A New Vision for Human Work After Automation
featured.summaryEn: Model capabilities get distributed to everyone and become the floor; what stays scarce is the human perspective and responsibility used to steer, rank and select model output — "generation is cheap, ranking is hard." This episode is Every CEO Dan Shipper's closing talk at Every's first conference, on what great human work looks like after automation. He contrasts two ways of predicting the future: the "aggregate" (extrapolating trend lines, e.g. OpenAI's GDPval, where blind expert graders preferred AI over human experts 12.4% of the time with GPT-4o in 2024, 47.6% in 2025, and about 83% with GPT-5.4 in 2026) and the "intimate" (zooming in on a real case). In one week, in the cracks of his calendar and with a single Claude subscription, he analyzed a customer survey, built a team video game, vibe-coded his own CRM and ran outreach — work that in 2020 terms took a data scientist, game dev…
featured.insightZh: 模型能力会普惠成为人人可得的“地板”，真正稀缺的是人基于自身职责和视角去驱动、排序和取舍模型输出的能力——“生成很便宜，排序很难”。 这一期是 Every CEO Dan Shipper 在 Every 首届大会上的闭幕演讲，主题是“自动化之后，伟大的人类工作是什么样子”。他区分了两种预测未来的方法：“聚合视角”（收集大量数据外推趋势，如 OpenAI 的 GDPval——专家盲评中 AI 胜过人类专家的比例从 2024 年 GPT-4o 的 12.4% 升到 2025 年的 47.6%、2026 年 GPT-5.4 的约 83%）和“亲密视角”（深入一个真实案例再外推）。他自己上周用一个 Claude 订阅，在日程间隙完成了客户问卷分析、做了团队对战小游戏、vibe code 了自己的 CRM 并发起外联——按 2020 年标准相当于数据科学家、游戏开发、产品营销、工程师和 BDR 五个人的工作。 但同一份问卷交给团队，每个人得出的洞见截然不同：增长工程师 Yash 发现首月订阅者因邮件过多而流失并直接提了 PR；市场负责人 Douglas 发现读者普遍感到“孤独”；编辑 Jack 做了个黏土动画版答题节目。而 Claude 的默认分析虽然正确，却人人可得、因此廉价。Every 的评测负责人 Mike Taylor 实验发现，Claude 在给出 400 个候选时有 93% 能覆盖 Dan 在 Slack 里会说的话，但让它排序时，Dan 的真实回答只有约 60% 进入前 10%。 Dan 的结论是：明年模型更强时，比较对象不是“2026 年的 Yash vs 2027 年的 Claude”，而是“用着 2027 年 Claude 的 2027 年 Yash vs 默认提示词”——两边的模型可以“约掉”。他据此重申“分配经济”（allocation economy）观点：人的价值在于分配和管理智能资源；AI 评测也应从“共识型问题”转向“从我的视角做我的工作做得有多好”，非共识的视角才是 alpha。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch argued AI should be pointed toward human understandability and conceptualization: a Riemann proof should come with a paper, a walkthrough, new concepts and insights — just as high-level code remains a valuable intermediate representation even if LLMs could output CPU instructions directly. He also warned that "free ZDR stealth model" inference offers are likely mechanisms of industrial-scale data exfiltration to nation-state programs, citing Dragos research as apparent confirmation, and…
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 认为 AI 应该更多指向“人类可理解性与概念化”：比如黎曼猜想的证明应配套论文、讲解、新概念与洞见，就像即便 LLM 能直接输出 CPU 指令，高级代码这种中间表示依然有价值。他还警告所谓“免费、ZDR（零数据保留）的隐身模型”推理服务，怀疑其是面向国家级项目的工业规模数据外泄机制，并称 Dragos 的研究似乎印证了这一点；Vercel AI Gateway 在不走这些捷径的情况下积累了大量真实 token 量，并预告将进一步提升信任、隐私和安全标准。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie said that as agents take on long-running project work and swarms of agents parallelize against a goal, agent harnesses and orchestration architecture must evolve. A key shift is how agents share knowledge, track tasks, and coordinate with humans — conceptually simple but complex to get right so agents access relevant resources without too much or too little exposure. Lessons can come from how people collaborate (shared files, chats, inboxes), but the primitives must operate at far higher throug…
items.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 认为，随着 Agent 承担越来越多长周期项目工作、出现围绕同一目标并行协作的 Agent 集群，Agent harness 与编排架构必须演进。最大的变化之一是 Agent 之间如何共享知识、追踪任务并与人类协同——技术上看似直接，但要在资源访问上做到既不过度也不不足地暴露，复杂度很高。可以借鉴人类协作方式（共享文件、聊天、收件箱），但相关原语必须支持远高于人类的吞吐，并应对 Agent 更容易成为安全风险载体的问题。

items.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: Peter Yang shared a quote from Charles Lamanna (EVP, Microsoft Copilot): "Agents are very harsh customers." When agents become the main users of software, they'll seek the best performance, price and reliability, and their preferences won't always match a person's. A human search returns 10 links with snippets; an agent can take a thousand results. APIs and user experiences will evolve modes that better support agents.
items.insightZh: Peter Yang 分享了微软 Copilot EVP Charles Lamanna 的观点：“Agent 是非常苛刻的客户。”当 Agent 成为软件的主要用户，它们会只看性能、价格和可靠性，偏好未必与人相同；人搜索时只需 10 条带摘要的链接，Agent 则可以一次接收上千条结果。因此 API 和用户体验将演化出更适配 Agent 的模式。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad said desktop AI apps are generally a security and privacy nightmare, and Replit worked with Windows to ship a world-class security model for Replit Desktop — which is why Christie's, the preeminent custodian of rare art, chose Replit for secure agentic work.
items.insightZh: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 指出桌面端 AI 应用普遍是安全与隐私噩梦，Replit 与 Windows 合作为 Replit Desktop 打造了一流的安全模型；正因如此，全球顶级艺术品机构佳士得（Christie's）选择 Replit 来开展安全的 Agent 化工作。

items.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
items.summaryEn: Every CEO Dan Shipper commented on an aviation incident possibly caused by an AI-assisted cyber attack: if attackers can interfere with a plane's and pilot's knowledge of its own weight, remaining fuel and location, the post-9/11 security measures against human hijackers become irrelevant; even with manual overrides, it's extremely tricky in low visibility. He noted he isn't an expert on aircraft systems and invited those who know more to weigh in.
items.insightZh: Every CEO Dan Shipper 评论了一起疑似 AI 辅助网络攻击导致的航空事件：如果攻击者能干扰飞机和飞行员对自身重量、剩余燃油和位置的感知，那么 9/11 以来防范人类劫机者的安保措施都可能失效；即便多数飞机有手动接管，在能见度差时仍极其棘手。他强调自己并非航空系统专家，并邀请懂行的人补充信息。

items.title: Nan Yu · OpenAI Codex 产品
items.summaryEn: Nan Yu, product at OpenAI Codex and former head of product at Linear, joked that he found a secret prompt that makes all vibecoded projects scale and perform better with higher reliability: "Use Postgres."
items.insightZh: OpenAI Codex 产品负责人（前 Linear 产品负责人）Nan Yu 调侃称找到了一个让所有 vibecoding 项目扩展性、性能和可靠性更好的“秘密提示词”：“Use Postgres”。

items.title: Ryo Lu · 曾任 Cursor / Notion / Stripe 设计
items.summaryEn: Ryo Lu built ryOS Karaoke, native on iOS, almost one-shotted with @airbuild — half-fold the iPhone Duo and it becomes a tiny karaoke machine.
items.insightZh: Ryo Lu 用 @airbuild 几乎一次生成了 iOS 原生的 ryOS Karaoke；把 iPhone Duo 半折叠起来，就成了一台迷你卡拉 OK 机。

items.title: Matt Turck · FirstMark Capital 合伙人
items.summaryEn: FirstMark VC Matt Turck observed that in 2026 tech street advertising completely took over NYC — every billboard, subway car and taxi — making it look like SF, and he doesn't love it. He also quipped that AI has failed to solve the most intractable math problem: how VCs will return huge funds when entry valuations exceed $1B pre-product.
items.insightZh: FirstMark VC Matt Turck 观察到，2026 年科技公司街头广告彻底占领了纽约——广告牌、地铁车厢、出租车随处可见，让纽约看起来像旧金山，他坦言并不喜欢。他还调侃：AI 仍未解决最难的数学题——当交易入场估值在产品出来前就超过 10 亿美元时，VC 要如何回本这些巨型基金。
